evidence: Market news leading up to May 12, 2022, is heavily dominated by the systemic collapse of Terra/UST and associated forced liquidation of Luna Foundation Guard's BTC holdings. Reports indicate Bitcoin breached below key support at $28.6K to multi-year lows, alongside over $1.27 billion (40,620 BTC) moving rapidly onto exchanges signaling intense continuing sell pressure. While there is minor positive corporate adoption news (Nubank 1% treasury allocation) and extreme fear metrics suggesting oversold conditions, ongoing contagion and liquidity dumping heavily weigh down the probability of a net positive 24-hour close.
limitations: All available evidence originates from unverified free crypto news sources rather than authenticated primary wire services.
Rapidly evolving market crisis and cascading liquidations from the Terra/UST collapse heighten volatility and the risk of sharp mean-reversion bounces.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
